errors.what: Crank angular speed is wrong. The spec requires one revolution per 4 s (90 deg/s, 30 deg per frame), but the sim advances only 9 deg per 0.333 s (27 deg/s, a period of about 13.3 s). At t=3.67 s the crank is at 99 deg instead of 330 deg, and the frames never complete a revolution. The panel crank_deg and piston_x values match this slow motion, but both disagree with the spec at every t>0 (e.g. t=1.00 should be 90 deg with piston x=113.14, but it shows 27 deg and 154.26 mm).
